description: K₄NaCl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Immm space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six KCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of K-Cl bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.13 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with four KCl₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eleven KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of K-Cl bond distances ranging from 3.11-3.17 Å. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are four shorter (2.91 Å) and two longer (3.10 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to six K atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-5°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four K and two equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent K and two equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°.
